gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-new-tai: Bellota Text lays fine rope into letter shapes, while Noto Sans New Tai Lue sits below in cupped, rounded forms. Its strength shows in large, brief lines of text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Unvarying weight, open curves: Bellota Text sets a commanding tone from word to word. Noto Sans Old South Arabian settles in beside it, approachable, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-palanquin: Palanquin reads with wide, unclosed curves and a contemporary hand, while Bellota Text bends its strokes without any thinning at the joints. The heading face belongs where words are large and few.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-pontano-sans: Contemporary through and through, Pontano Sans keeps its c terminals wide open beneath Bellota Text, which turns corners with no pressure swell. Paragraphs in it would run smooth and easy-going.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sansation: Approachable curves in Sansation turn without any ink pooling, while Bellota Text cuts its glyphs as if from strips of equal width. One is made to command a line; the other, to carry the text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shippori-antique: Modern, with a monoweight skeleton and open bowls tipped like a ladle, Shippori Antique sits under Bellota Text's commanding, open-shaped letters. What joins them is a shared openness of form.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tajawal: Clean lines run through both: Bellota Text bends cable-like strokes, and Tajawal gives its c a broad open hook. Neither font fusses, and each keeps its shapes simple and direct.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tasa-explorer: TASA Explorer ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, giving the text a clean, friendly stride. Bellota Text above it stitches thread-like strokes along each letter, and paragraphs below flow easily.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-trispace: Trispace spaces its sparse letters widely and lets curves open outward, while Bellota Text keeps stroke edges parallel through every bend. One makes a statement; the other gives room to breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ysabeau: Ysabeau reads in sweeping curves that never close up, with Bellota Text holding a steady line and no pressure variation above it. Their best feature is a shared, approachable openness.
